evidence.quote: The gallery programme began in 1984 in a Victorian terraced house in London’s East End.

findings.value: Contemporary art exhibitions across two Bethnal Green spaces, 4 Herald Street and 60 Three Colts Lane, with one show running in both: Rebecca Warren's 'There Will Be Another You'. No music nights listed.

notes: Art gallery, two Bethnal Green spaces (4 Herald Street, first floor, stairs only per the registry, and 60 Three Colts Lane). Shows seen: Rebecca Warren, 'There Will Be Another You', 9 Oct to 12 Dec 2026 (opening Thu 8 Oct 2026, 6 to 8pm); Frieze London stand B17, 14 to 18 Oct 2026 (a fair stand, not the gallery's own show). The about page says 'Studio M was opened in the Rochelle School in Shoreditch and operated from 2020 to 2026', which is not in Bethnal Green and is undated news; a person should check whether it matters.
